svg.title: Feedback workflow from draft to handling and expiry
svg.desc: Start the service, then prepare and review a draft. On acceptance, the report number is available for viewing and handling. The browser keeps uploading material while the server runs collection, notifications, and Webhooks. Export is optional. Expired reports are cleaned up automatically.
svg.metadata:
flowchart TB A["1. Start the feedback service
Set up database, private storage, and browser SDK"] B["2. Prepare and review a draft
Review evidence, mask images, or save a local ZIP"] C["3. Submit and get a report number
On failure, retry with the same ID and submitted data"] subgraph D["4. After acceptance, uploads and jobs run in parallel"] direction LR Browser["Browser uploads
Send files and evidence
Acknowledge completion"] Worker["Server jobs
Collect evidence
Notify and send webhooks"] end E["5. View and handle the report by number
Available immediately, even while evidence arrives"] F["6. Export a ZIP on demand
Freeze a snapshot, then download when ready"] G["Expiry cleanup runs for every report"] A --> B --> C C --> D C -->|"Number received"| E D -.-> E E --> F C -.-> G

g.text: Set up database, private storage, and browser SDK
Review evidence, mask images, or save a local ZIP
3. Submit and get a report number
On failure, retry with the same ID and submitted data
5. View and handle the report by number
Available immediately, even while evidence arrives
Freeze a snapshot, then download when ready
4. After acceptance, uploads and jobs run in parallel
Expiry cleanup runs for every report
